unmapped_findings: Fe-9 wt.% Al alloy is expected to exhibit short-range ordering (in contrast to Fe-7Al, which is a totally disordered solid solution) [b0009].
Fe-9Al VIM ingots were sound and completely free from microcracks as well as hydrogen gas porosity [b0018].
Fe-9Al produced by VIM exhibited excellent hot workability, in contrast to the poor hot-working response (microcracks) of Fe-9Al produced by AIMFC [b0041].
Measured composition of Fe-9Al VIM (wt.%): Al 9.10, Si 0.11, Mn 0.042, S 0.0027, C 0.014, O 0.0023, H 0.0021, N <0.001 [b0036/Table I].
It has been demonstrated that Fe-9 wt.% Al alloy can be produced by VIM only; AIM gave gas porosity and AIMFC gave microcracks [b0064].
